rows.title: Chat runtime — real provider call, no echo
rows.testName: Copilot Runtime Pipeline — real provider path, no echo, fail-closed (tests/platform/copilot-runtime-pipeline.test.ts, 26 tests)
rows.evidenceProves: The LIVE provider round trip IS proven as of 2026-10-21: the pinned primary candidate gemini_free/gemini-3.6-flash answered HTTP 200 (PROVIDER_CALL_SUCCEEDED, 1440 ms, transport live, servedBy direct_model, 161 in / 29 out tokens), the second candidate gemini_free/gemini-3.5-flash-lite answered HTTP 200 (999 ms), and the third candidate openrouter/nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free answered HTTP 200 (6042 ms) — the 20 Okt HTTP 429 quota wall and the HTTP 404 third-candidate wall are both gone. On the same live path the actor gate held (no server actor => status unavailable, reason ACTOR_NOT_VERIFIED, 0 provider calls, client-supplied actor in the body ignored), no response echoed the prompt (answer != prompt, canary absent), and the run budget held (maxModelCalls 3, modelCallsMade 1, deadlineMs 30000, latency <= 6042 ms, output tokens <= 3072 cumulative / <= 1024 per call, input <= 24576). CAVEAT: the HTTP 429 (PROVIDER_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED) branch was NOT exercised live on 2026-10-21 because every live candidate answered 200 on the first attempt; it remains unit-proven in tests/platform/copilot-runtime-contract-quota.test.ts and must not be re-proved by deliberately exhausting the 20/day free tier.

supersedes.reason: Re-tiered to verified_local / live_verified after a REAL live provider probe on 2026-10-21 (7 probes, HTTP 200 on the pinned primary, the second and the third candidate; actor gate, no-echo and the 3-call/30s/token budget all held). The 20 Okt external gate (Gemini free-tier HTTP 429) no longer applies: the quota window has recovered.

rows.externalGate: CopilotKit Intelligence account + Self-Service Agreement + organization on the free Developer plan + a selected project (project API key) + a Learning container created in the browser (stable id) + 15 eligible threads before the first learning run; Automatic Learning itself IS included in the free Developer plan, so this is not a paid-plan gate. supersedes.reason: Re-tiered to blocked_external after an independent adversarial review. The requirement names a hosted/offering activation that is externally unavailable, so a local or synthetic proof does not close it (contract line 179). External gate: The browser-side MCP client API and the live own-app registration are not available in this environment.

rows.title: Voice
rows.testName: Mic permission indicator, revoke, shared run identity, untrusted transcript, processing disclosure (tests/platform/ext-06-voice.test.ts)
rows.externalGate: This gate was mislabelled: CopilotKit voice is a plain open-source runtime feature, not a hosted Intelligence offering. The documented path is a runtime transcriptionService (@copilotkit/voice TranscriptionServiceOpenAI) which makes /info advertise audioFileTranscriptionEnabled:true and the mic button appear; without it the route answers 503 service_not_configured. The real external requirement is an STT provider credential, not an Intelligence account and not terms. No entitlement for voice is mentioned anywhere in the CopilotKit docs.
rows.evidenceProves: The browser Web Speech path is real and proven: the mic permission indicator, one-click revoke, the shared run identity with the copilot thread, the untrusted-transcript marking and the processing-location disclosure. No external STT/TTS is claimed.

rows.title: Attachments / multimodal
rows.testName: Attachment reference carries hash, permission and revocation; a revoked attachment fails the set (tests/platform/ext-07-attachments.test.ts)
rows.gap: The upload security model and the attachment reference surface are real and tested, but the copilot route does not yet pass attachmentIds through, and there is no vision inference.
rows.externalGate: Gate sebenar: model vision yang LAYAK untuk memahami imej (data scope diluluskan) — BUKAN akaun CopilotKit Intelijen. Bukti live 2026-10-21: `nvidia/nemotron-3-nano-omni-30b-a3b-reasoning` menjawab HTTP 200 (2821 ms) dan membaca imej dengan betul; `gemini_free/gemini-3.8-flash` HTTP 200 dengan imej ditelan (1104 token input). Batasan: kuota provider (20 permintaan/hari) dan terma provider semasa. Refusal 409 QUALIFIED_VISION_MODEL_REQUIRED kekal sebagai laluan felloh apabila model tidak layak — bukan "tiada model".
rows.evidenceProves: The upload security model and the attachment reference surface (hash, permission, revocation) are real and tested, and a revoked attachment fails the whole reference set. The copilot route does not yet pass attachmentIds through and there is NO vision inference, which is externally gated.
rows.remainingRequirement: The copilot route does not yet pass attachmentIds through, and there is no vision inference.

schema.note: status, environment and integrationStage are independent fields. A component/unit/synthetic pass does not close an acceptance that still requires protocol, live, browser or domain evidence. `remainingRequirement` is explicit: when it is non-null the row cannot be closed even when the local proof is green.
